title: Sustainable Development Goals SDGs 2030
definition: A universal call to action adopted by all United Nations Member States in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, comprising 17 integrated goals balancing economic growth, social inclusion, and environmental protection.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper II (International Relations, Governance, Government Policies) and GS Paper III (Inclusive Growth, Economy, Environment, Sustainable Development), as well as Prelims factual mapping of goals, targets, and NITI Aayog indices.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sustainable Development Goals SDGs 2030.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of economic development, inclusive growth, and environmental economics.
